title: Cryo-EM Structural Determination of VPS13C
author: Dazhi Li
materials: Manually curate micrographs and discard poor-quality images.
Pick particles and extract them for downstream analysis.
Generate initial 3D models by ab initio reconstruction.
Estimate final resolutions using gold-standard FSC at the 0.143 criterion.
Refine the selected particles by non-uniform refinement.

steps.title: Plasma clean EM grids
steps.instruction: Clean Quantifoil R1.2/1.3 300 mesh gold grids (2 nm continuous carbon film, catalog 668-300-AU) using an oxygen/argon plasma in a Gatan Solarus Advanced Plasma System.

steps.title: Apply sample and incubate
steps.instruction: Apply 3.5 µL of concentrated VPS13C (~0.04 mg/mL) to the cleaned grid and incubate for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Blot and plunge‑freeze grids
steps.instruction: Blot the grid for 1.5 s at blot force −12 in a Vitrobot Mark IV set to 8 °C and 100 % humidity, then plunge‑freeze in liquid ethane cooled by liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Clip, screen, and store grids
steps.instruction: Clip the frozen grids, screen them for ice quality, and store the selected grids in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Load grids into Titan Krios
steps.instruction: Load the pre‑screened grids into a Titan Krios transmission electron microscope operated at 300 kV and equipped with a BioQuantum energy filter and a K3 direct electron detector.

steps.title: Acquire cryo‑EM data
steps.instruction: Using SerialEM, set super‑resolution mode to 0.534 Å/pixel with a defocus range of −2.0 to −2.5 µm, then collect movies:

substeps.instruction: Collect 4,140 movies at 0° tilt and 4,914 movies at 25° tilt (to mitigate preferred orientation).
Record each movie for 2.896 s as 50 dose‑fractionated frames, giving a total dose of 42.7 e⁻/Å².

steps.title: Motion correction and CTF estimation
steps.instruction: Perform motion correction and contrast‑transfer‑function (CTF) estimation in CryoSPARC (v4.6.2, Structura Biotechnology Inc.).

steps.title: Iterative 2D classification
steps.instruction: Run iterative 2D classification in CryoSPARC to remove junk particles and retain good particle classes.

steps.title: Local/focused refinement with masks
steps.instruction: Apply local or focused refinement using masks to improve density of flexible regions.

steps.title: Heterogeneous refinement and class selection
steps.instruction: Perform heterogeneous refinement to separate particle populations and select the best class for downstream analysis.
